mapper.select: SELECT c.id FROM class c WHERE c.head_teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND c.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM teacher_class WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND class_id = #{classId} AND subject_id = #{subjectId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM teacher_class WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND class_id = #{classId} AND subject_id = #{subjectId}
mapper.select: SELECT tc.class_id AS classId, c.class_name AS className, tc.subject_id AS subjectId, s.subject_name AS subjectName, (c.head_teacher_id = tc.teacher_id) AS isHeadTeacher FROM teacher_class tc JOIN class c ON c.id = tc.class_id AND c.deleted = 0 JOIN subject s ON s.id = tc.subject_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE tc.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY c.class_name, s.subject_name
